_readme: Overview section order plan. Each string is a section title placed at that position (must match trainer_parties.h comment titles exactly, except manual-only sections like Oak's Lab). Each integer N pulls the next N sections from the standard order defined in trainer_parties.h that have not been placed yet. After the plan finishes, any remaining standard-order sections are appended automatically. Leave "plan" empty to use trainer_parties.h order unchanged.
